In examples they used "生产、销售假药", "非法拘禁", "放火", etc. So we need to output the crime name exactly as in law: "非法添加食品添加剂". Should we include "罪"? The format: [罪名]...<eoa>. In examples they wrote "[罪名]盗窃<eoa>" without the word 罪. So the content inside brackets is the crime name without the suffix 罪? Actually they wrote "盗窃". That's the crime name (the word 盗窃). For "非法拘禁", they wrote "非法拘禁". So we should output "非法添加食品添加剂". Check if any other nuance: Could be "生产、销售有毒有害食品"? But they didn't produce, just added. The crime is "非法添加食品添加剂". So final answer: [罪名]非法添加食品添加剂<eoa>
